主要内容: Brookfield Asset Management Inc. filed a Form 6-K with the SEC on March 31, 2017. The filing includes Exhibit 99.1, which incorporates by reference the Registration Statement on Form F-10 (File No. 333-213909). The company indicated it files annual reports under Form 40-F. The filing includes details about the company's principal executive offices located at Suite 300, Brookfield Place, 181 Bay Street, P.O. Box 762, Toronto, Canada M5J 2T3. The report was signed by Brian D. Lawson, Chief Financial Officer, on behalf of the registrant. The filing is part of the company's annual reporting obligations under the Securities Exchange Act of 1934. The document does not contain any specific financial results or operational updates beyond the regulatory filing requirements. The filing is related to the company's compliance with U.S. securities regulations and does not provide new information about its business operations or financial performance.
